0022600126.text: The Grizzlies, playing their fourth game of the season, come in 3-0 on a three-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West with a 2-0 road record. The Utah Jazz are 1-2, have lost their most recent game, and are 11th in the West and 5th in the Northwest, 2 games back. Memphis leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 123-103 win in Memphis on October 21, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26. Karim Lopez is day-to-day for Memphis with a knee bruise and is a game-time decision, while Utah is without Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), all listed as out.
